messages.content: I need to log out the system with my credentials.

function.name: user_authentication_login
function.description: Authenticates a user by their credentials and returns an authentication token. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

username.description: The username of the user attempting to log in.

password.description: The password associated with the username.

remember_me.description: A flag indicating whether the user's session should be remembered across browser restarts.

login_attempts.description: The number of consecutive failed login attempts. After a certain threshold, additional security checks may be required.

security_token.description: An optional security token for two-factor authentication. Required if two-factor authentication is enabled for the user.
